text: Incoming customer calls enter the sales and service operations workflow.
Calls are received and managed within the call center infrastructure.
Recorded audio files are processed and converted into transcriptions using speech-to-text software before being transmitted onward.
The central Hadoop ecosystem stores the call transcript data, serving both development and production environments.
Within the development cluster, data analysis, ranking model design, and testing are conducted before deploying models to production.
The production cluster hosts the deployed Call Satisfaction System.
Pipelines execute data processing, batch scoring, and business logic to generate representative satisfaction index scores in output tables.
Finally, managers and analysts access the aggregated satisfaction metrics through monitoring dashboards for reporting and interventions.
